name: Flashlight
author: Ava
description: Flip the torch on or off from Home Assistant. Handy light in one tap.
detail_description: Expose a torch switch in Home Assistant. Turn the camera LED on or off from automations, dashboards, or voice — useful as a night light, a closet lamp, or to light a scene before a camera snapshot. State is read from the system, so it stays correct when Android turns the torch off by itself.
